Author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
Name: PF Analysis
Description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; keep your listing alive on its own clock; browse and join the recruitment board for your data centre; and look up party members' progression and the clears they have posted.
Punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, a recruitment board with a Join button, party progression, and player lookups.
Changelog: Ratings are gone. Nobody can vote on anybody any more, no scores are shown anywhere, and the window that appeared after a duty has been removed. The Players tab keeps search, profiles, clears and everyone you have met. A new Party Finder tab lists every recruitment listing anyone on your data centre has seen - your own data centre or any other - in cards or a compact list, with search, paging and a watch on any listing. Join any party on your own data centre straight from the board: it opens the listing, checks it as it stands this second - seats, your job, one player per job, item level, completion requirement, level and unlock - and tells you in a sentence why if it cannot let you in. Alliance raids get a Join for each party separately. Plugin parties also take applications from other data centres: press Apply, stay free until the listing is full, then accept and PF Analysis travels to the host's data centre and joins you in - or press Join party now to go straight in without waiting. Your own listing reaches the board the moment you post it rather than the next time somebody happens to browse, and Refresh on your own data centre reads the Party Finder there and then so the board matches the game exactly. Auto Refresh now runs off your listing's own clock and says when it is checking, when it is refreshing, and why a refresh is being held up; the setting is Refresh at N min left, and every refresh is checked 30 seconds later and tried again if it did not take. The whole plugin has had a new look - line icons, iOS rows, switches, steppers and dropdowns, a sidebar instead of a settings page list - plus a Feedback tab for bug reports, feature requests and questions. Clears now reach everybody in the same second instead of up to two minutes apart. Fixed a listing being written with a healer seat turned into a fifth DPS, a full party staying on the board as 8/8, stepping away from the keyboard looking like you had stopped recruiting, a page-forward arrow that stopped working on page two, a clear banner that drew over other windows but was behind them for clicks, and a search box whose cross could not be pressed.
